description: This file defines the AliasPartHandler class, which manages the lifecycle and validation of AliasPart objects within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles alias validation, creation, updating, publishing, unpublishing, removal, cloning, and alias generation with uniqueness checks.
external_methods: Async methods for cache removal and alias uniqueness checks

classes.name: AliasPartHandler
classes.description: Handles lifecycle events and alias management for AliasPart objects in OrchardCore.

methods.name: ValidatingAsync
methods.description: Validates the alias if not empty during content validation.

methods.name: PublishedAsync
methods.description: Removes alias tag from cache when content is published.

methods.name: RemovedAsync
methods.description: Removes alias tag from cache when content is removed, if no active version remains.

methods.name: UnpublishedAsync
methods.description: Removes alias tag from cache when content is unpublished.

methods.name: CloningAsync
methods.description: Clones AliasPart and generates a unique alias for the clone.

methods.name: ComputeAliasAsync
methods.description: Generates and assigns a unique alias based on a pattern if alias is empty.

methods.name: GetPatternAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the alias pattern from content type settings.

methods.name: GenerateUniqueAliasAsync
methods.description: Generates a unique alias by appending version numbers if necessary.
